title: Puzzle Explorer
shareTitle: Puzzle Explorer 🗺️ — A Papercraft World Match
description: Carry animals, foods, and famous landmarks to their continents on a tactile papercraft world map, with recorded teacher guidance, gentle hints, and a travel-passport celebration.
learningGoals: Build a beginning mental map of the six inhabited continents
Connect familiar animals, foods, crops, and landmarks with broad world regions
Practice purposeful dragging, tap-to-place, visual search, and recall
interactionModel: drag a large picture card onto a geographically shaped continent, or tap the card and then tap a generous continent target
feedbackModel: Correct matches pulse, pop into the map, announce the continent, share one short fact, and fill a passport stamp; misses glide home with a gentle spoken nudge and no penalty.
